scope: Post-Veranda public website and two-book reader audit
fixes: Corrected low-contrast award labels and source text, and reader motion-setting help text.
Matched fallback font widths and prioritized the homepage display font to prevent late reflow.
Prevented stale bookmarks from claiming a different page after typography or viewport changes; mobile resume now validates layout before restoring its scroll offset.
Replaced a stale fallback chapter-count expectation with the maintained contents count; deployment now runs all Python regression tests.
Upgraded the Pages deployment actions to official Node 24-compatible releases.

validation.accessibility: WCAG A/AA automated checks on 12 representative mobile pages, with final desktop and light/dark reader checks: no remaining violations in checked states. This is not a full accessibility certification.

performance.profile: Cold local assets, 390px mobile, 1.6Mbps download, 150ms latency, 4x CPU slowdown. Lab observations, not field Core Web Vitals.

limits: No production message, comment or like was submitted during this audit.
Firestore emulator rules and the typed-field emulator backup round trip were not rerun; isolated backend checks and dependency audit passed.
Browser checks used Chromium; a manual Safari/iPhone pass remains useful.
Author editorial decisions and manuscript review remain in the shared review workflow.
